name: Jinzhou Yongshan Lithium Co., Ltd
summary: Jinzhou Yongshan Lithium Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in research and development, production, and sale of battery-grade lithium carbonate and battery-grade lithium hydroxide in China. The company also offers anhydrous lithium hydroxide. Its products are used in power batteries for new energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, and batteries for consumer electronics products. The company also exports its products. Jinzhou Yongshan Lithium Co., Ltd was founded in 2003 and is based in Changsha, China.
